prop.notes: Basic bool/scalar/string/enum/color/vector paths implemented. See docs/EVENT_PROPERTIES.md. Pointer typing starts immediately; rejected commits preserve the editor. Native button-pointer callback overrides for collection owners, unqualified setter side effects, unnamed/nonassignable targets, broader collection coverage and exact reference acceptance remain open. See docs/POINTERS_AND_DECORATORS.md. Real 200-choice window input and runtime behavior pass on 5.1.2/5.2.2; 600 batch-equal motion frames cover three scales. Modifier-specific flag persistence, separators/icons, specialized tabs, unqualified dynamic callbacks and exact reference acceptance remain open. See docs/ENUM_PROPERTIES.md.
